episodes.label: Season 55 Full-Season Recap · Nov 13
episodes.title: Hitmen Radio: Season 55 Full-Season Recap
episodes.headline: The Rimouski ruling, the final standings, and who exceeded or fell short in Season 55
episodes.description: Graham and David look back on LGCHL Season 55, starting with the ruling that overturned 22 Rimouski wins and reshaped the final standings: Moncton finishes first and Quebec takes the last QMJHL playoff spot. Then the final conference races, the league leaders, the teams that exceeded expectations and the ones that fell short, an open line with the callers, and a first look ahead to the playoffs. The Hitmen finish eighth and miss out. Season 55. Every point mattered.

Graham and David break down Calgary's perfect Sunday — three wins, two in overtime — plus the WHL East race, Surges and slides around the LGCHL, and tonight's posted playoff-pressure matchups from Medicine Hat at Calgary to Victoriaville at Blainville. Season 55. Every point matters.

episodes.label: Trade Deadline Special · All In or All Out · Nov 9
episodes.title: Hitmen Radio: Season 55 Trade Deadline Special: All In or All Out
episodes.headline: 209 trades, 14 in the final 17 minutes: Graham and David break down the Season 55 deadline
episodes.description: Two hundred and nine trades. Fourteen in the final seventeen minutes. Graham and David break down the LGCHL Season 55 trade deadline: Halifax going all in for pickmasta, Victoria selling two plus-forty-nine players in one day, and Red Deer's morning shopping spree. Then Trade or Bust, our top 10 countdown of the riskiest deals, headlined by Swift Current's last-minute reshuffle. And the Hitmen? Five straight wins, tied for a playoff spot, with six games left. Every trade is a promise. The real verdict comes on the ice.
